disclaimer: Lookup flags for agents — not legal advice. Prefer omission + human review when unsure. last_checked is editorial.
human_review_rule: If category.requires_human_review is true, put HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED in AI disclosure & rights and do not invent compliance copy.

banned_copy_shapes: exclusive neighborhood vibe excluding protected classes
required_actions: Declare Meta Special Ad Category = Housing when applicable
Avoid discriminatory targeting and exclusionary lifestyle copy
Use inclusive housing language; show equal housing opportunity if advertiser supplies mark
housing.notes: Fair housing risk is high — when unsure, omit targeting suggestions and flag human review.

required_actions: No performance promises unless USER_SUPPLIED + legal-approved
Include advertiser-supplied disclosures only — do not invent APR/legal lines
credit.notes: Lending/credit/investing ads may need platform authorization and legal review.

employment.notes: Declare Employment SAC; keep requirements job-related and non-discriminatory.

required_actions: Prefer problem-scene without diagnosing the viewer
No disease-cure claims without USER_SUPPLIED regulatory-approved copy
Beauty: cosmetic desire OK; clinical % only if USER_SUPPLIED

kids.notes: Prefer parent-directed messaging; follow platform age policies.

restricted_verticals.action: Emit approval/age-gate banner; only use USER_SUPPLIED claims; check platform certs; never invent before/after medical outcomes
